photos.title: Myrtle Beach Golf and Yacht Club from above
photos.what: Part of Myrtle Beach Golf and Yacht Club from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): small houses close together along curving streets and cul-de-sacs, with a pond running through the middle and a grass strip beside it.
photos.caption: Part of Myrtle Beach Golf and Yacht Club from the air. The houses sit close together on small lots.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Myrtle Beach Golf and Yacht Club in Socastee: small houses close together along curving streets, with a pond running through the middle

place.sublocation: Myrtle Beach Golf and Yacht Club

photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size on 2026-11-17 with the county lot centers drawn over it. Every house in the frame is on a Myrtle Beach Golf and Yacht Club lot (122 house lots in the frame); the newer houses and the large building at the right edge of the full export were cut out. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
